milestone: M15: standalone bounded Python compute gateway

implementation.http: Node 24 built-in HTTP, no new npm runtime dependencies
implementation.ml: existing Python modules and web/lib validation/training/prediction handlers reused without modification
implementation.authentication: constant-time hashed service-token comparison; at least 32 base64url characters; no browser CORS
implementation.model_isolation: separate ModelStore per trusted 64-hex session, not public user-login implementation
implementation.lifecycle: bounded Python runtime, kill/reap on disconnect or timeout; private upload/model cleanup and graceful shutdown
implementation.runtime_import_closure: 10 source modules, only node: external imports

integration.fixture: synthetic numeric 120-row CSV; not a new real energy research experiment
integration.six_methods_plus_none: all train over HTTP; exact selected features/CV/Holdout equality with original handlers
integration.comparison: all six methods; 8 fixed points and 2 automatic methods
integration.single_batch_delete: all seven model choices predict and delete; two batch rows include missing-feature imputation
integration.session_isolation: existing session B cannot infer or delete A model even when given A model ID
integration.expiry_capacity: expired sessions pruned, session cap enforced, failed train does not reserve a model session
integration.payloads: stale confirmation, auth/path/method/session, multipart CSV cap, declared/chunked whole-body cap tested
integration.cancellation: disconnected worker process killed, slot released
integration.timeout: worker killed after test timeout and temporary files removed

docker.image_contents: explicit COPY of gateway, src and required lib source only; raw CSV/reports/models/secrets excluded
